description: This Java class implements a generic cache named ComparableCache for storing key-value pairs where the values are Comparable. It supports retrieving values and updating entries only if the new value is greater than the existing one, utilizing Caffeine cache for internal storage.

classes.name: ComparableCache
classes.description: A thread-safe cache for Comparable values that updates only when new values are greater.

methods.name: ComparableCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing cache with maximum size and optional cache name, setting up Caffeine cache.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key, null if not present.

methods.name: updateIfNewOrGreater
methods.description: Updates the cache entry for a key only if the new value is greater than the existing one, returning true if updated.
